transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I came in today because... I just feel like I cannot settle inside my own skin anymore. It's like I constantly have to jump up and do the next thing. Even when I'm completely worn out and I know I should just be sitting still, I just can't seem to do it.
During these times, do you also feel unusually up or irritable?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel... you know, unusually happy or high or anything like that. It's just this restless feeling. I mean, I guess I get a little frustrated sometimes because I just want to sit down and rest, but I wouldn't say I'm irritable or angry.
Do these restless feelings ever come on as sudden surges of intense fear or panic?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't get... sudden fear or panic or anything like that. It's not a scary feeling, it's just... well, it's just that constant need to be moving. So no, no panic.
Have you felt this constant need to be moving ever since you were a child?

Yes, I really have. It's been this way for as long as I can remember. Even back in grade school, my teachers would write notes saying I was a bright girl, but... just careless. I was always losing my papers, or talking out of turn. They were constantly having to give me reminders to just stay in my seat and actually finish my work. So, yes, it's been a lifelong thing.
Do you spend a lot of your time worrying about many different things?
No, not really. I mean, I have normal concerns like anybody else, but I don't spend my time just... worrying about a bunch of different things. So, no, I wouldn't say I'm much of a worrier.
